newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound up against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound up against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound continued to rise against the dollar on Monday in a private sector market flush with the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"Everyone is offering dollars," said one banker. "The pound could get stronger."
"The spread is quite narrow because there are so many dollars on the market," said another banker.
Five actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3880 and 3.3920 bid and at between 3.3890 and 3.3930 offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Monday was 3.3896 bid and 3.3912 offered. These averages compare to 3.39125 pounds bid and 3.394875 pounds offered on Sunday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.389575 buy and 3.397079 sell.
